thread:
Maya (PM): quick sync — ACME wants an early-access private pilot for Q3. Need alignment on capacity, security signoff, runtime gating, and rollout criteria. Can we map owners and a sequence by EOD Monday?

Alex (Eng): what qps/tokens are we sizing for? and model size/quantization?

Maya (PM): customer expects ~30 rps peak, avg 8 rps. Mostly short prompts (~40 tokens in, 60 out). They asked for a 13B quantized variant if feasible.

Riley (Eng): 13B quantized is fine but we need to confirm latency at 30 rps with continuous batching. Also depends on KV cache hit rate — need a prewarm plan.

Sam (Runtime): prefix/KV caching -> good to know. For private deploys we currently have automatic prefix cache but not cross-tenant warm pools. For pilot we can enable aggressive prefix caching + small dedicated prewarm pool. Canary plan recommended: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic fallback to hosted model variant.

June (Infra): slot ask: for pilot target we should reserve 4 GPUs in staging, 8 GPUs in pilot pool (burst to 12 for peak). Prewarm pool needs to be separate from shared capacity. Also need network egress rules for customer VPC peering.

Zara (Security): heads up — we need a quick threat model and KMS/HSM integration review. If they require HSM-backed keys, schedule is +2 weeks for procurement + config. PCI/PHI review? not required per initial ask but confirm.

Maya (PM): great — here's a proposed sequence. comments? owners?

Alex (Eng): looks sane. small tweak: do an internal perf smoke with synthetic workload before security signoff so we can catch obvious perf regressions early.

Riley (Eng): agree. also add a small prompt set (10–20 golden prompts) for quality regression checks during canary.

Sam (Runtime): +1 on golden prompts. Also propose runtime feature gate flags: 
```
FEATURES:
 - prefix_cache=true
 - dedicated_prewarm_pool=pilot-acme
 - fallback_route=hosted-13b-quant
 - streaming=false (pilot: use non-streaming to simplify tracing)
```

June (Infra): owners: I can own prewarm infra and VPC peering. ETA to provision staging GPUs: 3 business days after approval.

Zara (Security): I will own KMS/HSM review and threat model. Earliest complete: 10 business days unless they accept soft KMS (not HSM).

Maya (PM): owners noted. We need explicit launch gating criteria — propose the following minimal gates:
- security signoff (KMS or documented mitigation)
- perf: p95 latency <= 300ms for 40-token in / 60 out under pilot load
- error rate <= 0.5%  (5xx / request)
- golden prompt pass rate >= 95% (fuzzy match + manual spot check)
- infra: staging prewarm pool provisioned and smoke-tested

Alex (Eng): ok with those. add: rollback plan documented and a canary abort metric (p95 > 500ms or error rate > 1%).

Maya (PM): added. I'll create a short playbook doc and link it to the pilot ticket.

Riley (Eng): who will run canary monitoring? do we have SLO dashboards ready?

Sam (Runtime): runtime team will own canary metrics and automated fallback. We need a short dashboard: throughput, p95 latency, 5xx rate, cache hit rate, and token cost. I can sketch it.

June (Infra): infra will add alerts for GPU OOMs, node restarts, and network flaps.

Zara (Security): security will subscribe to the canary channel and will run a post-deploy quick audit checklist (confirm key rotations, access controls, audit logs).

Maya (PM): ok owners:
- Product (Maya): coordination, playbook, customer comms
- Eng (Alex/Riley): perf smoke, golden prompts, rollback doc
- Runtime (Sam): feature flags, canary automation, dashboards
- Infra (June): prewarm pool + VPC peering + alerts
- Security (Zara): KMS/HSM review, threat model, post-deploy audit

Maya (PM): tiny launch checklist I'm dropping here — please ack ownership inline.
```
- security_signoff: pending (owner: Zara)
- perf_smoke: pending (owner: Alex)
- golden_prompts_ready: pending (owner: Riley)
- prewarm_pool_provisioned: pending (owner: June)
- dashboard_connected: pending (owner: Sam)
- rollback_playbook: pending (owner: Alex)
- canary_policy: pending (owner: Sam)
- customer_kms_decision: pending (owner: Maya)
```

Alex (Eng): ack perf_smoke + rollback_playbook.

Riley (Eng): ack golden_prompts_ready. I'll post prompts by tomorrow noon.

Sam (Runtime): ack dashboard_connected + canary_policy. I'll push the feature flags to pilot branch.

June (Infra): ack prewarm_pool_provisioned. provisioning starts after infra ticket approved.

Zara (Security): ack security_signoff (working on threat model). Advising customer on soft vs HSM KMS decision.

Maya (PM): customer_kms_decision -> I'll push them for soft KMS for pilot to avoid procurement delay; will record their response by Friday.

Alex (Eng): ETA notes: perf smoke plus local runs -> 48 hours once infra ready.

June (Infra): provisioning ETA updated: 2 business days if soft KMS; 10 business days if HSM needed.

Maya (PM): perfect. I'll update the pilot ticket and add dates. Thanks all.
